name: Mei Ling Tan
bio:
Mei Ling's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, fueled by a childhood fascination with dismantling and rebuilding her father's vintage motorcycle. This early tinkering evolved into a passion for engineering, leading her to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering from the National University of Singapore. After graduating, she honed her skills in a local fabrication shop, mastering welding, machining, and composite materials. 

Her meticulous attention to detail and unwavering commitment to quality quickly caught the eye of a racing team competing in the Asian Le Mans Series. She spent several seasons with them, contributing to chassis development and aerodynamic improvements. Mei Ling's approach to fabrication is rooted in precision and a deep understanding of how each component contributes to overall performance. She believes in continuous learning and is always seeking innovative solutions to enhance the car's reliability and speed. Her work ethic and forward-thinking mindset make her a valuable asset to the Aston Martin team, where she aims to push the boundaries of motorsport fabrication.

 Mei Ling brings a unique blend of traditional craftsmanship and modern engineering principles to the Aston Martin team. She is known for her ability to troubleshoot complex problems efficiently and her dedication to maintaining the highest standards of quality. Her experience in diverse racing environments has given her a keen understanding of the challenges faced by the team, and she is passionate about contributing to their success.
